bullets.text: Cellnex Delivers for VodafoneThree - **Cellnex** has launched its first consolidated site for **VodafoneThree**, enhancing 4G and 5G coverage.
Verizon's Major Layoffs - **Verizon** plans to cut 15,000 jobs as part of a strategy to streamline operations amid fierce competition.
Nokia Expands Data Center Portfolio - **Nokia** introduces new switches to enhance data throughput for AI workloads in data centers.
Vodacom Partners with Starlink - **Vodacom** will use **Starlink** for mobile backhaul, improving rural connectivity across Africa.
Deutsche Telekom Focuses on AI - **Deutsche Telekom** reports strong fiber gains and emphasizes AI as a core business pillar.
Amazon Leo Launches Satellite Service - **Amazon** rebrands its satellite initiative to **Amazon Leo**, aiming for a competitive edge in LEO services.
Private 5G and AI Convergence - The integration of **private 5G** and **generative AI** is reshaping industrial connectivity.
Connected Germany 2025 Conference - Industry leaders will gather to address Germany's digital challenges and connectivity roadmap.
SoftBank Deepens AI Commitment - Following a strategic exit from **Nvidia**, **SoftBank** is increasing its investment in **OpenAI**.
Altnets Thrive in the UK - Predictions of a consolidation crisis for UK altnets have not materialized, indicating strong competition.
